consumed.resolution: Closed not-observed / already-fixed on the item's own first acceptance criterion ("telemetry first: … close as not-observed if none"). No cancel-laundered ExitArtifactTimeout was found for stdout/git-contract phases, and the defect the item scoped was generalized away after it was filed: go/internal/bridge/completion.go's withFinalPoll hands the one post-cancel completion poll a context.WithoutCancel context bounded by finalPollGrace and marked with finalPollCtxKey, so stdoutDetector.poll (CapturePane) and gitEvidenceDetector.poll (git) run on a LIVE ctx on the final look instead of failing closed — the parity the item asked for, via an explicit finality signal rather than the per-detector last-observation snapshot the item sketched. artifactDetector.poll is re-keyed off isFinalPoll(ctx) || ctx.Err() != nil so the live final ctx does not disarm its short-circuit. Evidence: go/internal/bridge/completion_cancel_parity_test.go — TestTmuxREPL_StdoutContract_CancelAfterIdle_CompletesNotTimeout, TestTmuxREPL_GitContract_CancelAfterEvidenceCommit_CompletesNotTimeout, TestTmuxREPL_CancelAfterDeliverable_CompletesNotTimeout, TestArtifactDetector_CtxCancelledShortCircuitsDebounce — 4/4 PASS in cycle-1529. Recorded (not deleted) so it can be re-opened if that suite ever goes red.

summary: go-reviewer LOW on the 2026-07-16 cancel-after-deliverable fix (driver_tmux_repl.go): the on-cancel final detector.poll gives benign-completion semantics only to the ARTIFACT contract, because artifactDetector.poll is a pure file stat (ctx-independent). stdoutDetector/gitEvidenceDetector polls (completion.go:107,191) depend on ctx-bound CapturePane/git calls, which fail closed under an already-dead ctx — so a router/advisor-style phase using the stdout or git contract whose ctx dies just after its completion condition was met still exits ExitArtifactTimeout (the pre-fix mislabel). Low weight: those phases are short-lived and the runner reconcile + settle-retry remain the safety net; fix only if telemetry shows the mislabel actually occurring for non-artifact contracts. Approach if pursued: give each detector a ctx-independent last-observation snapshot (mirror lastGoodPane) consulted on the cancel path — do NOT re-fork tmux under a fresh ctx (teardown races).
title: Benign-cancel completion parity for the stdout/git completion contracts (the 2026-07-16 driver fix covers only the artifact detector)
